title: $36B Wealth Firm Strategist: Bitcoin’s Supercycle Is “Still Intact”
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine $36B Wealth Firm Strategist: Bitcoin’s Supercycle Is “Still Intact” James Thorne, Chief Market Strategist at Wellington-Altus, tells BMTV that Bitcoin's super cycle is still intact after the drop from about 83,000 in mid-October to around 64,000. This post $36B Wealth Firm Strategist: Bitcoin’s Supercycle Is “Still Intact” first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
